newsitem.title: UK: UK's EMAP buys "The Box" cable music channel.
newsitem.headline: UK's EMAP buys "The Box" cable music channel.

text.p: British media group EMAP Plc said on Wednesday it bought "The Box" cable television music channel from U.S.-based Video Jukebox Network Inc and Ticketmaster Inc for $12.5 million cash.
The company said the purchase would apply only to the channel's UK operations.
EMAP also said it agreed to buy $2.5 million of convertible preference shares in Video Jukebox, which would give it a 6.5 percent stake in the company upon conversion.

The company said the UK interactive channel, which plays music videos selected by cable audiences from a specified playlist, would be profitable in 1997 with an expected turnover of about 2.0 million stg.
The channel is available to over 90 percent of the UK's 1.5 million cable homes, where it has a weekly reach of over 20 percent of its core audience, EMAP said in a statement.
